item.title: Richmond flyers caught in TSA chaos amid government shutdown: 'Pack your patience'
item.description: Travelers at some of the nation's busiest airports faced hours-long security lines Monday as a partial government shutdown entering its fourth week continues to drive a spike in TSA sick calls.

item.title: Gov. Spanberger leads Virginia public safety readiness briefing
item.description: Virginia Gov. Abigail Spanberger met with public safety leaders from across the commonwealth Monday as part of a "unified readiness" coordination effort.

item.title: Chesterfield County breaks ground on new Falling Creek police station
item.description: Chesterfield County leaders broke ground on a new police station Monday afternoon, marking the start of construction on a facility designed to improve emergency services for community members.
